(865)dam can chos srung rnams la phrin bcol bya tshul bzhugs/kye thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen 'bar ba'i snod/dgra bcom tshul khrims rjes su byed pa yi/ba

tei:div.tei:p: dam can chos srung rnams la phrin bcol bya tshul bzhugs/ kye thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen 'bar ba'i snod/ dgra bcom tshul khrims rjes su byed pa yi/ bslab gsum yongs 'du pa brtol ljon pa'i shing*/ nub pa med par 'phel ba'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ da dus snyigs ma lnga yis gzir ba 'di/ kun rtog drang don lam gyis gdul dka' tshe/ nges don byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod che'i/ yon tan byang chub sems gnyis rgyas par mjod/ (866)khyad par mig 'phrul lta bur 'gro ba'i lam/ rdo rje'i theg pa rgya mtsho'i smin grol dang*/ 'phags lam nges gsang theg pa mchog gi rtse/ kun nas kun tu dar ba'i phrin las mjod/ rgyal ba'i gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa dang*/ rjes su mthun par gsungs pa'i bstan pa la/ phyogs lhung phrag dog gdon gyis kun dkris can/ smon lam log pa'i dam sri'i snying khrag 'thung*/ gang gi dbang phyug lus can thams cad kyis/ khur du lci (867)ba sbrul gdug lta bu'i sems/ bstan 'gro'i phan bde bshig la chas pa der/ srung skyob mjad na khyed kyi g.yar dam 'dral/ log par lta ba 'jin dang kla klo'i sde/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa'i rgyal phran gyis/ chab srid skar mda' pa la ltung ba ltar/ byas pa'i mod la don snying lkogs mar phyung*/ mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong zhing*/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i dam tshig la 'gongs pa'i/ nag (868)phyogs glo bur lhags pa'i 'dre rgod dang*/ rgya 'dre brlang por spyod pa'i dus mtha' bstungs/ mang du thos pa lung gi yon tan dang*/ rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba'i skyes bu rnams/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag gcig tu gnas pa'i phyir/ sku tshe mjad phrin yar zla'i mchod po mjod/ khyim na gnas kyang yang dag blta la dad/ dkon mchog gsum la bla mar byed pa rnams/ theg pa chen po'i gdul bya nyid kyi phyir/ g.yel ba med pa'i (869)(870)mel tshe bsrung skyobs mjod/
chos dang srid kyi gzhi la phun tshogs spel/ byes su lam 'phrang chom rkun 'tshe ba srungs/ bsam don yi bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las kyang*/ tshogs gnyis 'bras bur smin pa'i bkra shis stsol/// /
